stories.title: Out, then back in. Korea’s relay team wins appeal to reach Asian Games final

en.title: Out, then back in. Korea's relay team wins appeal to reach Asian Games final
en.summary: South Korea's men's 4x100-meter relay team successfully appealed a disqualification and qualified for the Asian Games final scheduled for late Monday. The team had finished fourth in their heat on Sunday before officials initially disqualified them for an alleged baton exchange violation.

stories.title: S. Korea advances to men's 4x100m relay final after disqualification overturned

en.title: S. Korea advances to men's 4x100m relay final after disqualification overturned
en.summary: South Korea's men's 4x100-meter relay team advanced to the Asian Games final after organizers reversed a disqualification decision. The team had been initially disqualified during Sunday's heats for an alleged baton exchange rule violation.

stories.title: Korea beats Japan for fifth straight Asian Games baseball gold

en.title: Korea beats Japan for fifth straight Asian Games baseball gold
en.summary: South Korea defeated Japan 3-1 in the baseball final at the Asian Games in Aichi Prefecture, claiming its fifth consecutive gold medal and seventh overall title in the sport. The victory reversed an earlier loss to Japan in the Super Round.

stories.title: Korea beats Japan for first Asian Games handball gold in 8 years

en.title: Korea beats Japan for first Asian Games handball gold in 8 years
en.summary: South Korea defeated Japan 27-23 in women's handball at the Asian Games, claiming its first gold medal in the sport in eight years. Korea finished the tournament undefeated with a 6-0 record.

stories.title: S. Korea, UNC inspect site of suspected DMZ mine blast

en.title: S. Korea, UNC inspect site of suspected DMZ mine blast
en.summary: South Korean and UN Command personnel conducted an inspection operation in the western Demilitarized Zone on Sunday to examine the area where a suspected mine blast injured three South Korean officers the previous week. About 40 personnel, including troops, armistice commission members, and investigators, participated in the operation.

stories.title: S. Korea Wins Equestrian Dressage Gold After 12 Years

en.title: S. Korea Wins Equestrian Dressage Gold After 12 Years
en.summary: South Korean equestrian rider Nam Dong-heon won the gold medal in individual dressage at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, scoring 75.190 points with his horse Leonidas and reclaiming the title for South Korea after 12 years.
